ValidationRule.description: Blocks closing a Production Install Work Order that requires Quality Inspection until QI is complete. Scoped to the Production_Install record type so it never blocks lawn-care, aqua, customer-care, or other WOs. Part of P_QI_HomeBuilder QI.6.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed"), ISCHANGED(Status), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Production_Install", QI_Required__c = true, QI_Complete__c = false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Work Order requires a passing Quality Inspection before it can be Closed. The QI must reach Approved status (any failed item routes to Customer Care for rework and re-inspection).
